clips.label: Petal crosses the opening
clips.details:
The two local turns pull a near orchid across the central opening. The flower becomes prominent and the new railway is pushed toward the lower edge. This is an instructive alternative, not a successful clearing of the opening.

Each painting repaints the warped previous painting with Krea Turbo, three Euler intervals and CFG1. All comparisons keep the text, seeds and noise curve fixed; only spatial motion changes. Lanczos warps run on the source timeline. RIFE 4.25 scale 1 supplies intermediate frames. Delivery is 24 fps at 1.5× source speed: three paintings per second. These excerpts begin at the shared original frame 384, omitting the identical opening.

clips.label: Reverse the regional turns
clips.details:
Reversing the two local turns moves the opening upward and exposes a large perforated ivory form. The railway leaves the upper edge and the ivory structure becomes dominant. This gave us the wheel-like shape used in a later clockwork-world branch.
